notes: 'This is Jerusalem' puts the supplied copula on the predicate noun, the demonstrative subject keeping only its own word (rule 20).
'countries are round about her' puts the copula on the locative predicate rather than on the subject noun (rules 20, 49).
The suffix of אֲדֹנָי is unrepresented and the supplied 'the' goes to the nominal expression (rules 15, 22).
